pairing.multipleRequests: {{name}} received {{count}} pairing requests. Only approve the one matching eta setup on that computer.
pairing.verifyFingerprint: Verify the fingerprint matches the one printed in that computer’s terminal before approving.
pairing.commandFingerprintHelp: The command prints a fingerprint in that computer’s terminal. Approve only when it matches the one shown here.
pairing.label: pairing
pairing.multipleRequests_one: {{name}} received {{count}} pairing request. Only approve the one matching eta setup on that computer.
pairing.multipleRequests_other: {{name}} received {{count}} pairing requests. Only approve the one matching eta setup on that computer.

install.permissionsNotice: Agents run with full permissions on that computer. Only connect computers dedicated to work.
install.commandExpiry: This command works once and expires at {{time}}.
install.commandExpiryDefault: This command works once and expires in 24 hours.
install.requirements: Requires Node.js 24.13+ and a running Paseo daemon or Herdr. Installs the agenvo connector and eta command as startup services. {{expiryHint}}
install.waitingForCommand: Waiting for the command to run on that computer…

update.description: Update eta and the agenvo connector to the version currently provided by Eta{{versionSuffix}}, and connect to Eta’s current relay address.
update.commandHelp: This downloads eta, installs the new connector, updates the relay address and restarts their services without pairing again. Running Paseo and Herdr agents will continue. The command works once and expires in 24 hours. Running it invalidates the computer’s previous token.
update.waitingForReconnect: Waiting for the computer to reconnect. If the connector has changed and needs approval, verify its fingerprint against the terminal before approving.
update.versionMismatch: Some computers have an agenvo connector that differs from Eta’s version{{version}}. Choose “Update” on the computer and run the command there.

limits.description: Maximum concurrent task runs on this computer. Primary execution, assistance and reviews each count as a run. Paseo and Herdr share this limit.
limits.label: Concurrent runs
limits.queueHelp: Runs exceeding the limit are queued and start in order as slots become available.
limits.slotUsageHelp: A run occupies a slot from opening its workspace until it completes, fails or stops. Active runs still occupy slots while the computer is offline.
limits.loweringHelp: Lowering the limit does not stop active runs. New runs follow the new limit after they finish.
limits.loweredHint: Limit lowered: new runs wait for active runs to finish
limits.atCapacity: At capacity; new runs are queued

offline.help: If an offline computer is powered on, its connector may be outdated or the relay address may have changed. Choose “Update connector” from its “⋯” menu and run the command on that computer.

revoke.confirmDescription: Its tasks will become unassigned{{activeRunsHint}}. To reconnect, add the computer again.

empty.relayNotConfigured: The server has no agenvo relay configured. Remote computers cannot be connected yet.
empty.title: No computers connected yet
empty.description: Once connected, tasks can be assigned to its Paseo or Herdr agents.
